Hi Eric,

Thank you for the details and for the DHL conversation, that helps a lot. You are right that DHL will only take this up with the sender, and since the parcel was sent from the Amazon.nl account rather than from your order, that is on us to do, not on you.

I have put it in front of the colleague who holds that account so the investigation can be opened with DHL and the pickup code chased down. They start at 10am Eastern today and it is the first thing on their list. You will get the answer here in this thread, so you do not need to contact DHL again yourself.

If the parcel cannot be released to you quickly, we will simply send you another power supply rather than let you wait on an investigation.

I am sorry you have had to chase this so many times, Eric. It should not have taken this long.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
